findings.claim_text: Comfy Org announced $30 million at a $500 million valuation on 2026-04-24, led by Craft, bringing total funding to $47 million — and has NEVER disclosed revenue, ARR, or a paying-customer count in any first-party document.

The Comfy Registry API reports 4,993 published node packs as of 2026-08-05, roughly one-twelfth of the company's advertised "60,000+ nodes" — and the company's own same-day press release contradicts its own blog on both total funding ($48M vs $47M) and daily downloads ("50K" subheadline vs "150,000+" body).

ComfyUI added a Contributor License Agreement on 2026-07-06 whose PR-comment template names enabling a future relicense under a more permissive license as the most important benefit — and Partner Node credit prices reproduce the underlying providers' public list prices, so Comfy Org's visible take rate on API calls is approximately zero.
findings.contradicting_quote: This creates a usage-based revenue stream where ComfyUI takes a margin on API calls
